turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on and, but and because?

The rule: use and to add a second idea to the first one.
Right: Ali cooks lunch and Ali cleans the house. Wrong: Ali cooks lunch. And cleans.
Now you. Join with and: "I have a cat. I have a dog."
